review.readiness_note: Visual sign-off for the two captured desktop Recreate states. The composite seam is not a page defect. Static captures cannot verify sticky handoffs, Inspect dialog behavior, navigation destinations or backend actions, and the other homepage chapters are outside this review.
review.why: This is a faithful translation of the approved language, not a reproduction of the Lab layout. The graphite surface, tight display typography, operational captions and cobalt conditional-money plane preserve Frame Shift's hierarchy. The still reference remains identifiable within the real product frame, and inspection is exposed outside it. The $75.00 headline is immediately qualified by its payment basis, net amount, fee and approval condition. In the later capture, the unchanged frame position and explicit Revision requested caption preserve continuity without pretending that scrolling advanced a customer's work. Home, Activity, Earnings, Profile, Save and original-reference affordances remain represented inside the captures; the public page separately exposes entry and inspection actions. Specific work, a real revision note and honest financial semantics make this read as a working consumer platform rather than a generic SaaS feature showcase. No release-blocking drift is visible in this chapter.
review.verdict: Yes—the captured desktop Recreate chapter faithfully carries Frame Shift into the production product story, with no visible loss of functionality or misleading state progression.
